text: This might be nothing but thought I'd check. My son is 11, he's been running a temp since yesterday and it was 39.4 when I took it about twenty minutes ago. Streaming nose, sneezing non stop, all blocked up. He's had runny poos a couple of times today too. He's drinking loads though and weeing like normal so I don't think he's drying out. Is 39.4 too high for his age or is this just a nasty cold doing the rounds? Feel a bit daft messaging at this hour
